facts.fact: 这座宅子是他自己挣钱、自己督造出来的，八年来几乎天天泡在园子上
facts.anchor: I’d earned the funds to pay for it, had overseen its construction, and spent nearly every minute of the last eight years on the grounds.

facts.fact: 那场事故之后医生说他能活下来算走运，他当年不信，如今也不信
facts.anchor: You are fortunate to be alive, the doctors had said after the accident.

facts.fact: 他绝不会让"完美的"Caroline Grey 看见自己的伤疤
facts.anchor: Never would I let the perfect Caroline Grey witness such ugliness.

facts.fact: Camilla 没敲门就走进 Zane 的办公室质问他
facts.anchor: Finally, after what seemed an eternity, Camilla entered my office. Without knocking.

facts.fact: Zane 交代他早先看见 Caroline 肩膀疼得发抖，怀疑 Orson 在虐待她
facts.anchor: She was wincing. Her shoulder. I think he is mistreating her.

facts.fact: Zane 的私家调查员 Silas Cribbs 号称全城最好，他要把 Orson 的生平彻底翻出来
facts.anchor: Silas Cribbs was my personal investigator and the best in the city.

facts.fact: 自从 Caroline 开始为 Mr. Bishop 的藏书编目，Orson 对她的亲昵变得越来越粗暴
facts.anchor: A reprieve from his intimacies, which had grown increasingly rough ever since I started to work on cataloguing Mr. Bishop’s library.

facts.fact: Orson 说只要他一句话，仆人就敢把 Caroline 关在屋里
facts.anchor: If I tell them to lock you indoors, they will.
